column12: JUDGEMENT on the comparator: the TTR silencer in the same two diseases, launched worldwide by a US biotech that built its own ex-US business. Regeneron's co/co is worldwide, with Intellia as lead party. Case for lower: Intellia has no ex-US commercial presence, the lonvo-z seed takes Orladeyo's 0.1173 for that reason, and European HTA bodies have been slow to pay $2mm-plus one-time prices. Case for higher: ex-US hATTR-PN is a larger share of the disease (Amvuttra's PN-only FY2024 split read 0.539, (235.441 + 104.396) / 630.613), and tafamidis reads 0.664 (Pfizer FY2025)
